story.title: AI Form Builder UI and Agent Loop
story.domain: Builder UX, AI orchestration, validator-driven retries

pm-confirmations.item: Single-page generation is locked for Story 6.2
Retry cap is 3 system correction attempts per generation request
Initial provider integration is ChatGPT API (provider key via local environment)
Global Properties menu includes AI Agent, Inspector, and Logic switch options

story-context.objective: Deliver an MVP Builder flow where natural-language input drives AI DefinitionJSON generation, validator-informed retries, and safe canvas load of validated output.

in-scope.item: Builder UI prompt entry for AI form generation via Global Properties switcher (`AI Agent`, `Inspector`, `Logic`)
AI generation state machine (idle, generating, validating, retrying, completed, failed)
Retry loop using Story 6.1 validator response contract
Validated DefinitionJSON load into Builder canvas
Versioned LLM Context Pack consumed by generation flow

dependencies.dependency: Structured fields: valid, schemaErrors, boundaryViolations, collisions, summary
Provider credentials configured locally (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY in backend/.env)

must-include.item: Product usage context and refinement flow
Validator error to correction mapping rules
One valid and one corrected example

agent-owned.item: Frontend automated tests for state transitions and error handling

human-owned.item: UX acceptance of prompt quality and messaging clarity

done-criteria.dc: AI prompt entry UI available via Global Properties switcher and functional
Versioned context pack exists and is consumed by generation pipeline
Validator-driven retry loop operates deterministically with max-attempt cap of 3
Validated payload loads without Builder crash
Failure states are explicit and user actionable
Green gate evidence captured via workflow scripts
Tool feedback logged for process improvement
